description:
Get the Google Search Console index-coverage summary for a property: how many of its tracked (sitemap-submitted) URLs Google actually indexes, derived from the same data as the SEOcrawl Indexation tool. Returns known_urls, indexed, not_indexed and indexed_pct (each as current/prev/delta), sitemap_urls, and by_state — the URL count per Google coverage state ("Submitted and indexed", "Crawled - currently not indexed", "Discovered - currently not indexed", "Excluded by 'noindex' tag", "Page with redirect", "Not found (404)", "Soft 404", …). IMPORTANT: only indexed carries a real prev/delta (the daily metric records the same indexed count, so its end-of-prev-period value is a true comparison). known_urls/not_indexed/indexed_pct prev/delta are null, and by_state carries no prev/delta — Google reports only the latest state per URL (no daily coverage history) and the daily metric's known count is the plan-capped tracked-list size, not the coverage inventory, so it cannot be compared over time. known_urls counts only the URLs SEOcrawl tracks and the plan caps that list, so on a larger sitemap it is a subset of the site, NOT its size — never report it as the page count. sitemap_urls is the URL count the property's sitemaps actually declare, per Google's own Sitemaps API (null unless Google has reported every registered sitemap in the past week — never a partial sum); when it exceeds known_urls, say plainly that coverage is measured on known_urls of sitemap_urls URLs. indexed_pct is a percentage (0–100) of known_urls. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties. Returns feature_not_available when the property's plan does not include Indexation.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Index-coverage summary with per-state breakdown for the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

name: get_indexation_summary
title: Index coverage summary
